SELECT SUM(TOT_RDCNT) AS statsCo
, SUBSTR(OCCRRNC_DE, 1, 4) AS statsDate
, CONCAT(CONCAT(SUBSTR(OCCRRNC_DE, 1, 4), '-'), SUBSTR(OCCRRNC_DE, 5, 2)) AS statsDate
, CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT(SUBSTR(OCCRRNC_DE, 1, 4), '-'), SUBSTR(OCCRRNC_DE, 5, 2)), '-'), SUBSTR(OCCRRNC_DE, 7, 2)) AS statsDate
FROM SBBSSUMMARY WHERE 1 = 1
AND OCCRRNC_DE BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND STATS_SE = #{statsKind}
AND DETAIL_STATS_SE = #{detailStatsKind}
GROUP BY statsDate ORDER BY statsDate

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(TOT_RDCNT) / SUM(CREAT_CO), 0) AS avrgInqireCo
, SUBSTR(OCCRRNC_DE, 1, 4) AS statsDate
, CONCAT(CONCAT(SUBSTR(OCCRRNC_DE, 1, 4), '-'), SUBSTR(OCCRRNC_DE, 5, 2)) AS statsDate
, CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT(SUBSTR(OCCRRNC_DE, 1, 4), '-'), SUBSTR(OCCRRNC_DE, 5, 2)), '-'), SUBSTR(OCCRRNC_DE, 7, 2)) AS statsDate
FROM SBBSSUMMARY WHERE 1 = 1
AND OCCRRNC_DE BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND STATS_SE = #{statsKind}
AND DETAIL_STATS_SE = #{detailStatsKind}
GROUP BY statsDate ORDER BY statsDate

select.if: SELECT COUNT(a.NTT_ID) AS creatCo FROM NBBS a, NBBSMASTER b WHERE a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID AND TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, 'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND b.BBS_TY_CODE = #{detailStatsKind}

SELECT COUNT(a.NTT_ID) AS creatCo FROM NBBS a, NBBSMASTER b, NTMPLATINFO c WHERE a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID AND TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, 'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND b.TMPLAT_ID = c.TMPLAT_ID AND c.TMPLAT_SE_CODE = #{detailStatsKind}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.RDCNT),0) AS totInqireCo FROM NBBS a, NBBSMASTER b WHERE a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID AND TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, 'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND b.BBS_TY_CODE = #{detailStatsKind}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.RDCNT),0) AS totInqireCo FROM NBBS a, NBBSMASTER b, NTMPLATINFO c WHERE a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID AND TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, 'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND b.TMPLAT_ID = c.TMPLAT_ID AND c.TMPLAT_SE_CODE = #{detailStatsKind}

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(a.RDCNT),0) AS avrgInqireCo FROM NBBS a, NBBSMASTER b WHERE a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID AND TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, 'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND b.BBS_TY_CODE = #{detailStatsKind}

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(a.RDCNT),0) AS avrgInqireCo FROM NBBS a, NBBSMASTER b, NTMPLATINFO c WHERE a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID AND TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, 'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND b.TMPLAT_ID = c.TMPLAT_ID AND c.TMPLAT_SE_CODE = #{detailStatsKind}

SELECT a.NTT_ID AS mxmmInqireBbsId FROM NBBS a, NBBSMASTER b WHERE a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID AND a.RDCNT = (SELECT MAX(c.RDCNT) FROM NBBS c, NBBSMASTER d WHERE c.BBS_ID = d.BBS_ID AND c.RDCNT > 0 AND TO_CHAR(c.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND d.BBS_TY_CODE = #{detailStatsKind}) AND TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND b.BBS_TY_CODE = #{detailStatsKind} LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT a.NTT_ID AS mxmmInqireBbsId FROM NBBS a, NBBSMASTER b, NTMPLATINFO c WHERE a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID AND a.RDCNT = (SELECT MAX(d.RDCNT) FROM NBBS d, NBBSMASTER e, NTMPLATINFO f WHERE d.BBS_ID = e.BBS_ID AND d.RDCNT > 0 AND TO_CHAR(d.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND e.TMPLAT_ID = f.TMPLAT_ID AND f.TMPLAT_SE_CODE = #{detailStatsKind}) AND TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND b.TMPLAT_ID = c.TMPLAT_ID AND c.TMPLAT_SE_CODE = #{detailStatsKind} LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT a.NTT_ID AS mummInqireBbsId FROM NBBS a, NBBSMASTER b WHERE a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID AND a.RDCNT = (SELECT MIN(c.RDCNT) FROM NBBS c, NBBSMASTER d WHERE c.BBS_ID = d.BBS_ID AND c.RDCNT > 0 AND TO_CHAR(c.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND d.BBS_TY_CODE = #{detailStatsKind}) AND TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND b.BBS_TY_CODE = #{detailStatsKind} LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT a.NTT_ID AS mummInqireBbsId FROM NBBS a, NBBSMASTER b, NTMPLATINFO c WHERE a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID AND a.RDCNT = (SELECT MIN(d.RDCNT) FROM NBBS d, NBBSMASTER e, NTMPLATINFO f WHERE d.BBS_ID = e.BBS_ID AND d.RDCNT > 0 AND TO_CHAR(d.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND e.TMPLAT_ID = f.TMPLAT_ID AND f.TMPLAT_SE_CODE = #{detailStatsKind}) AND TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND b.TMPLAT_ID = c.TMPLAT_ID AND c.TMPLAT_SE_CODE = #{detailStatsKind} LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT (SELECT v.USER_ID FROM COMVNUSERMASTER v WHERE v.ESNTL_ID = c.topNtcepersonId) AS topNtcepersonId FROM (SELECT COUNT(a.NTT_ID) AS topNtcepersonCo , a.FRST_REGISTER_ID AS topNtcepersonId FROM NBBS a, NBBSMASTER b WHERE a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID AND a.FRST_REGISTER_ID IS NOT NULL AND TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND b.BBS_TY_CODE = #{detailStatsKind} GROUP BY a.FRST_REGISTER_ID) c WHERE c.topNtcepersonCo = (SELECT MAX(f.topNtcepersonCo) FROM (SELECT COUNT(d.NTT_ID) AS topNtcepersonCo , d.FRST_REGISTER_ID AS topNtcepersonId FROM NBBS d, NBBSMASTER e WHERE d.BBS_ID = e.BBS_ID AND d.FRST_REGISTER_ID IS NOT NULL AND TO_CHAR(d.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND e.BBS_TY_CODE = #{detailStatsKind} GROUP BY d.FRST_REGISTER_ID) f) LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0

SELECT (SELECT v.USER_ID FROM COMVNUSERMASTER v WHERE v.ESNTL_ID = c.topNtcepersonId) AS topNtcepersonId FROM (SELECT COUNT(a.NTT_ID) AS topNtcepersonCo , a.FRST_REGISTER_ID AS topNtcepersonId FROM NBBS a, NBBSMASTER b, NTMPLATINFO t1 WHERE a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID AND a.FRST_REGISTER_ID IS NOT NULL AND TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND b.TMPLAT_ID = t1.TMPLAT_ID AND t1.TMPLAT_SE_CODE = #{detailStatsKind} GROUP BY a.FRST_REGISTER_ID) c WHERE c.topNtcepersonCo = (SELECT MAX(f.topNtcepersonCo) FROM (SELECT COUNT(d.NTT_ID) AS topNtcepersonCo , d.FRST_REGISTER_ID AS topNtcepersonId FROM NBBS d, NBBSMASTER e, NTMPLATINFO t2 WHERE d.BBS_ID = e.BBS_ID AND d.FRST_REGISTER_ID IS NOT NULL AND TO_CHAR(d.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') = TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd') AND e.TMPLAT_ID = t2.TMPLAT_ID AND t2.TMPLAT_SE_CODE = #{detailStatsKind} GROUP BY d.FRST_REGISTER_ID) f) LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SBBSSUMMARY ( OCCRRNC_DE, STATS_SE, DETAIL_STATS_SE, CREAT_CO, TOT_RDCNT, AVRG_RDCNT, TOP_INQIRE_BBSCTT_ID, MUMM_INQIRE_BBSCTT_ID, TOP_NTCR_ID ) VALUES ( TO_CHAR(NOW() - interval '1 day', 'YYYYmmdd'), #{statsKind}, #{detailStatsKind}, #{creatCo}, #{totInqireCo}, #{avrgInqireCo}, #{mxmmInqireBbsId}, #{mummInqireBbsId}, #{topNtcepersonId} )
